name: Atomic DvP (bond ⇄ cash)
tagline: Bond delivered against cash in one atomic swap — the Regulator audits delivery, but the payment stays private
concept: A Delivery-versus-Payment that spans two privacy models in one trade. The bond is a Noto token (hooks mode): its notary (CSD) and the oversight group {CSD, Regulator} see every position. The cash is Zeto tokenised-deposit money: amounts are zero-knowledge, visible only to the owning bank. Both legs are locked and delegated to a single Atom contract, so they settle together or not at all. The result is a faithful asymmetry — the Regulator can audit the DELIVERY of the bond, yet is blind to the CONSIDERATION (the cash). 'Cash' is no one's column: each bank mints tokenised deposits to itself, and the payment is just a second, ZK-shielded movement between the same two banks.

consortium.name: Consortium member
consortium.role: On the chain · not a party to either leg

steps.title: Set up: bond (hooks) + Bank B's tokenised-deposit cash + Atom factory
steps.plain: The CSD forms a Pente oversight group with the Regulator and issues the bond as a Noto token whose policy runs in that group (hooks). Bank B mints its OWN tokenised-deposit cash (a Zeto, ZK) to itself. A shared Atom factory is deployed to settle trades atomically.

steps.title: CSD issues 1,000 BOND to Bank A
steps.plain: The notary and Bank A see the bond coin; the onMint hook records it in the Pente tracker, so the Regulator sees the position too — without holding anything. Bank B already holds its 25,000 of tokenised-deposit cash, which only Bank B can value.

steps.title: Both legs locked & delegated to the Atom (escrow)
steps.plain: Bank A locks 400 BOND and prepares its unlock to Bank B; Bank B locks 10,000 cash and prepares its transfer to Bank A. Each leg is delegated to one Atom contract. Nothing has moved yet — but neither party can now pull out unilaterally.

steps.title: Atomic settlement — bond ⇄ cash, all-or-nothing
steps.plain: One Atom.execute() runs both legs in a single base-ledger transaction: the bond unlocks to Bank B and the cash transfers to Bank A together. The CSD and Regulator see the bond change hands (via the oversight tracker); the cash amount stays ZK-hidden from them — they audit delivery, not the price.
